title: A tag must be separated from the flow mapping it marks, as a mapping value
notes: Same rule as parse/properties-need-separation-before-flow-collection, with a flow mapping inside a block mapping. The tag `!a` ends at `{` (a flow indicator is not a tag character), and the node that follows would have to be an empty one, which a collection cannot follow. `{` is the first character that cannot belong, column 6.

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted a tag written directly against the opening brace of a flow mapping.
